problem.symptom: 6-7 s on hosted; BFF alpha factory owner timeout 3 s, so BFF alpha factory and discovery acceptance probe report templates_read_failed
problem.prior_behavior: each request called ensure_builtin_alpha_templates (182 register_if_absent: 183 Postgres connections and 730 statements per request, measured) and PostgresRegistryStore.list_by_artifact_type went through list_all_selected's generic visible_sql path, which unwraps (payload || '{}') and detoasts every registry.entries row before filtering on artifact_type (30,705 shared buffers on the fixture)

solution.ensure_once: services/registry/alpha_template.py: ensure_builtin_alpha_templates_once (synchronous, no-op once ok for the same registry store object and library digest; failure recorded then raised), schedule_builtin_alpha_templates_ensure (daemon thread, never blocks the caller; failed attempts retried after BUILTIN_ENSURE_RETRY_SECONDS=60), builtin_alpha_template_status, alpha_template_library_digest (sha256 of the checked-in library files, re-hashed only when a file's mtime/size changes)
solution.research_routes: services/research/main.py: startup hook ensure_builtin_alpha_templates_off_request_path starts the once-ensure on a daemon thread; list and detail routes call only schedule_builtin_alpha_templates_ensure and return builtin_library {status ok|pending|running|failed|not_started, error, library_digest, template_count, attempts, duration_ms}; detail answers 503 builtin_alpha_template_library_not_ready (with builtin_library) instead of 404 when a template is missing while the library is not ensured
solution.evaluate_path: services/research/alpha_templates/evaluator.py run_alpha_template_evaluation uses ensure_builtin_alpha_templates_once (still raises on a collision)
solution.type_index: services/registry/pg_store.py: CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS <table>_artifact_type_idx ON registry.entries ((payload ->> 'artifact_type')) added to _ensure_artifact_catalog_indexes (forward-only, additive, no row/column/constraint change); list_by_artifact_type runs artifact_type_select_sql: object rows by the indexed expression UNION ALL legacy JSON-string rows through the existing partial legacy-string index, ordered by updated_at, same result as before

previous_release_compatibility: the previous release's list_all_selected type-filtered query still returns the same rows on the indexed table (test_real_pg_previous_release_read_and_rebootstrap_keep_working); the index is never required by old code and may be dropped at any time
